## Acceptance criteria, by layer

**Page.** `/sources/` retitled "Sources" (ST-01; SL-01 superseded in
batch-01 comment) and renders the K9 table between the counting block and
the licence disclosure. Three views: Overview (source, publisher, class,
geography, status, freshness, claims, download), Runs & freshness (source,
status, last successful run, last upstream change, last change in SIG's
records, cadence, freshness, runs, errors — release clock), Rights &
downloads (source, publisher, licence, redistribution, download, ground
truth). Sort routes `…/sort/<col>/<asc|desc>/` for every view column;
facets `/sources/by/<dim>/<value>/` for the 12 K9 dims (slugged values);
facet pages render the default sort only (no product). Rows carry
`id="src-<id>"` + `data-source/status/lane/freshness`; the A–Z list anchors
`az-<letter>` to the first row of each letter.

**Model.** `web/src/lib/sources-table.ts` composes `TableRow` from
`sig.source-row/1` + freshness + executions + registry extras; the
freshness verdict is the shared `freshness.jsonl` state with the bounded
K9 §5.1 derivation when the release carries none; registry-only rows are
`not_applicable`. `SourcesTablePage.astro` builds the per-page figure
registry (claims → `transparency/sources.json`, staleness →
`transparency/freshness.jsonl`, runs/errors →
`transparency/sources/<id>/executions.jsonl`, facet counts → named
predicates) — 46 figures per Overview page, `check:figures` clean.

**Shared row (K9 C-12).** `SourceTableRow.astro` is the one row component;
`/status/sources/` renders it via `SourceStatusRow.astro` →
`statusRowToTableRow()` adapter with the lane's runs-7d/failed-30d +
day-granular `Next run` cells, keeping status-clock labels honest and
release-bound fields absent. Column set matches Runs & freshness; the
status table's `claims_7d` figure was retired (supersession noted in
batch-07 comment + the page keeps its `runs_7d.total` figure).

**Exports.** `artifact/transparency/sources.csv` (RFC 4180, `#` licence
provenance comment lines, `-1` numeric absence + explicit tokens) and
`sources.schema.json` (generated Table Schema — one field per export
column, `primaryKey: source_id`). The served `transparency/sources.json`
is the same doc the API's `/v1/sources` serves — parity is a byte
identity, not a re-derivation.

**Redirects.** `/data-freshness/`, `/status/`, `/stale/`, `/volatility/`,
`/source/` → `/sources/…` equivalents through `redirectRules()`'s one
legacy map (K9 C-11); `stale`/`volatility` route to the runs view (their
data now lives in the freshness cell); the whole map is gated on the
emitted `/sources/…` targets. `/data-freshness/` emits no page.

**Page types + chrome.** `page-types.ts` classifies every new route T1 /
`sig.source-row/1` (literal `runs`/`rights`/`sort`/`by` patterns outrank
`/sources/*/`); `/status/sources/` gets its own `sig.status-lane/1` entry.
`gen-lhci.mjs` gains `/sources/runs/` (regenerated `lighthouserc*.json` —
the K9 "Lighthouse URLs"). Nav match drops `data-freshness/`;
`release-routes` drops the deleted probe. HowWeKnowThis "Data freshness"
link → `/sources/runs/`; index/methodology/search links repointed.

**Copy batch.** `batch-09.md` ST-01..ST-33 (page family `/sources/<table>/`
+ `/sources/` titles + shared headers `/status/sources/` reuses), all
pending B-2 verbatim confirmation; supersession comments on batch-01 SL-01
and batch-07 SS-09/SS-12/SS-14.

## Carried gate decision (verbatim, not re-decided)

`D-J3-2 [B-19] = yes: scrubbed run logs published (robots disregard
disclosed as host + count; W2-6)` — carried verbatim into this surface:
the table's run cells expose host-level outcomes only (per-source
`executions.json` artifacts); no per-URL robots detail.

`D-K10-1 [B-2] = OD-07 a` — carried verbatim: all new drafted sentences
are `pending` copy-batch rows; none reads as confirmed.

## Fix arc

1. JSX arrow-function `.map` bodies in `SourcesTable`/`SourcesTablePage`
   — Astro frontmatter rejects them; refactored to a precomputed fig map.
2. `data-freshness` route probes/tests/nav expectations retired in step;
   `HowWeKnowThis` link repointed (it sits on every page).
3. Bare numerals in run/outcome cells → wrapped the whole cell text in
   `<Figure>` (not just the headline number).
4. Facet route values slugged (`camera registry` → `camera-registry`) —
   `og:url` must match the emitted canonical path exactly.
5. Duplicate `<title>` between `/status/sources/` and `/sources/runs/` —
   status page retitled `Source status — runs and freshness`.
6. `/sources/by/...` LHCI/brand/url checks: added `sources/runs/` to the
   generated URL set; `lhci-generated.test.ts` names it.
7. `root-absolute-paths` baseline remeasured (`--write-baseline`) — the
   six new `path=` props count against it; `withBase()` on dynamic paths
   keeps the count flat (no new literals in dynamic routes).
